panels.description: Inside the opened Keel pump housing, patched wiring, a sinking pressure gauge, mineral-crusted fittings, and a narrow service channel surround Alex’s testing fingers. Keep the distant normal-allocation display separate from the balloon zone.
Alex loosens a corroded fitting; a weak spit of water strikes his scarred knuckles. Leave top-left for the SFX and right side for the dialogue stack.

Alex wedges up the lining, revealing a cleaner newer pipe vibrating hard and carrying water away. Bi11bot’s amber eye and finger emerge from the bag, pointing. Leave top-left for SFX and the right side for dialogue.

The concealed pipe disappears through the wall gap; its valve pulses and water travels away from the dry public line. Alex’s scarred hand and steel watch touch it. Leave top-left for SFX and bottom-right for Alex’s balloon.
